name: Phone (SIP)
author: arpena
description: The Echo as an extension of your phone system (Asterisk, FreePBX, a Fritz!Box): a doorbell or a phone can ring it, and Home Assistant can have it call one. A call rings until answered at the Echo. G.711, unencrypted: for your own network.

settings.name: server
settings.label: Phone system
settings.help: Your phone system's name or address (Asterisk, FreePBX, a Fritz!Box). Only this address can ring the Echo.

settings.name: port
settings.label: Port
settings.help: Its SIP port: 5060 unless it was changed there.

settings.name: user
settings.label: Extension (user name)
settings.help: The extension your phone system set up for this Echo: letters, digits and . _ + - * # only.

settings.name: password
settings.label: Password
settings.help: The extension's password. It goes to the phone system only as a digest.
